# SpriteBatchSettings

[Framework](README.md) · `DotGame.Framework.Graphics` · record struct

```csharp
public readonly record struct SpriteBatchSettings
```

How a sprite batch draws. Its defaults are the plain case: no transform, [`BlendMode.Alpha`](BlendMode.md#alpha) and [`Sampler.LinearClamp`](Sampler.md#linearclamp).
